I figured I'd return to FPH when I'm back to my old self so I wouldn't be a hypocrite.

To lose the weight, I retained my regular weightlifting workout but went the extra mile -- I increased my cardio exercises and had low-calorie meals delivered to me at the office for the whole of January. Because of the latter, a fat coworker approached me and asked me how to order because she also wanted to lose weight. She has been fat for as long as I've been working at our company, which is more than three years now. On her first day at around 8 am, I asked her how she found the breakfast meal. She said she liked it, but the portion was "very small." I told her that with 1,500 calories a day, the portion sizes were just right, but since she was just starting, it was normal that she'd have a challenge adjusting. Deep down, I wasn't surprised, especially when of my other coworkers said he was willing to bet that she would fail.
